# volcano_database_backup_schedule (Resource)

A database's automated backup schedule. This is a singleton per database: creating it sets the schedule, deleting it clears it (an empty entry list).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_database_backup_schedule" "main" {
  project_id    = volcano_project.example.id
  database_name = volcano_database.main.name

  entries = [
    {
      frequency = "daily"
      hour      = 3
    },
    {
      frequency         = "weekly"
      hour              = 4
      day               = 1
      retention_seconds = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_name` (String)
- `entries` (Attributes List) One or more recurrences. An empty list clears the schedule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `project_id` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Required:

- `frequency` (String) daily, weekly, or monthly.
- `hour` (Number) Hour of the day in UTC (0-23).

Optional:

- `day` (Number) Day of week (1-7, Monday-Sunday) for weekly, or day of month (1-28) for monthly. Required for both; ignored for daily.
- `retention_seconds` (Number) How long backups from this recurrence are kept. Defaults to the plan's retention when omitted.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_database_backup_schedule.main <project-id>,<database-name>
```
